title.narrative: Advocate for the Rights and Promote the Inclusion of Children with ASD in the Jordanian Society

description.narrative: The project has two specific objectives. The first one relates to strengthening the role of civil society organizations in promoting a rights based approach to the delivery of educational services to autistic children in Jordan. The second specific objective focuses on improving the access of autistic children (4-8 years old) to Jordan's formal education system. The project will be implemented in Amman and Aqaba.
